Employment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with customer and technical teams to understand implementation requirements.

* Troubleshoot deployment, integration and configuration issues.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, application deployment and enterprise technology environments.
* Ability to work across engineering and customer-facing activities.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

Forward Deployment Software Engineering APIs Integration Deployment Troubleshooting Technical Implementation Customer Engineering Enterprise Technology

Support Marketing Cloud journeys, automation studio, data extensions, and integration with Sales Cloud.
